answer: At the spinning shed the twine spinner feeds flax into the wheel and watches the thread draw thin and even. Knot linen mesh knitter sail bond is the watching: a bond linen mesh knitters lodge after knotting bench checks. The sparrow is the first thread drawn, the glacier the last before the bobbin fills, and the horizon is the bobbin, humming on its spindle. A cheat must spin 31 false threads and fill 31 false bobbins.
